summary.text: Rhetta Bowers is a Democratic state representative from Texas who has represented District 113 since 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Rhetta Andrews Bowers earned a bachelor's degree in telecommunications and studied at Spelman College and Texas Southern University.
Bowers assumed office in the Texas House on January 8, 2019, succeeding Cindy Burkett, a Republican.
In 2023 and 2024 she was assigned to the Criminal Jurisprudence, Homeland Security & Public Safety, and Local & Consent Calendars committees, serving as vice chair of the last.
